title: Report 04: how often does a SaaS pricing page change its price?
population: Pricing pages of the tools in our review corpus, captured automatically on the 2nd of each month; only pages with readable amounts in the first month and a fresh read in the second count.
selection: Automated diff flags candidates; a person reads the captured lines of both months and publishes only real price changes. Currency switches, failed captures, newly shown annual rates and promotions are excluded.

headline.text: monthly page comparisons showed a price change (all change types together)

limitations: Not a random sample: the tools we review.
The pooled rate adds two rounds of different size; each round is also reported on its own.
The 19 changes are four different kinds (increase, decrease, restructure, withdrawal), not 19 comparable price rises.
For the second round the page-by-page list of unchanged pages was not kept.
next_full_recheck: monthly: capture on the 2nd, published after review

corrections.what: The first version (2 September 2026) divided the 19 changes by 567 pages, which counted pages that could not show a change. The denominator is now the 430 comparable page pairs; the headline went from '1 in 30' to '1 in 23'.
